name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaFreeTime.free_time_accuracy
type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Family),
  0 < p.m →
    0 < p.n →
      0 < p.S →
        0 < p.ρ →
          p.ρ ≤ 1 →
            0 ≤ p.Lminus →
              0 ≤ p.Lpm →
                0 ≤ p.Δ →
                  0 < p.ε →
                    0 < outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyCoefficient p.toBase p.S p.ρ →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample p.m p.n →
                        ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ) (lower Lplus : ℝ),
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f p.x0 lower p.Lminus Lplus p.Lpm p.Δ →
                            ∀ (τ : Fin p.n → ENNReal),
                              Monotone τ →
                                ∀
                                  (O :
                                    OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
                                      (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
                                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent
                                        (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p true) f τ O →
                                      ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit
                                              (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p true) ≤
                                            N →
                                          let q := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p true;
                                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                                          have out := fun z =>
                                            OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q)
                                              (fun x => N) z.1 z.2;
                                          MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                              (fun z =>
                                                ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2)
                                              P ∧
                                            ∫ (z :
                                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                                  ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) (out z).1‖ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
                                                p.ε ∧
                                              ∫⁻ (z :
                                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                                  ↑(out z).2 ∂P ≤
                                                12 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +
                                                  ENNReal.ofReal
                                                      (48 * p.Δ / p.ε *
                                                        (p.Lminus + p.Lpm * √((1 - p.ρ) / (p.ρ * ↑p.S)))) *
                                                    (ENNReal.ofReal p.ρ *
                                                        outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +
                                                      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - p.ρ) *
                                                        outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.S)
